cues.text: introducing Allegro a fast simple
capillary blood analyzer for
point-of-care testing developed by nova
biomedical a world leader in
point-of-care in vitro diagnostics
Allegro and its stats trip a companion
meter provide 14 clinically important
tests to monitor glycemic control assess
cardiac risk with a full lipids panel
and assess kidney function Allegro
offers easy capillary sampling for all
blood tests and is the only analyzer
that can measure hba1c lipids glucose
and creatinine from a capillary sample
all tests are measured with disposable
ready to use cartridges or test strips
and can be easily performed by lay
personnel Allegro test results are
completed in minutes and are available
during the patient visit having
immediate results simplifies clinic
workflow and reduces follow-up calls
letters and patient visits while helping
to obtain the important benefits of
patient satisfaction compliance and
outcomes for more information click on
contact us at the Nova biomedical
website
